Specialization.Name: Tactician (reSpecialized) 1.01
Specialization.Description: [H4]Tactician (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]TACTICIAN—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Tactician is the perfect melding of the squad-based NCO and the battle commander. They manage the tactics, battle plan, and sometimes lead the charge against the enemy. [BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ⅕ Competent Ranged Combatant 2/5 Squad Commander 2/5 Ground Combat Tactical Leader[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Ground Combat Battle Planning[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Ranged Combat[BR] Survivalism[BR] Leadership[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Mercenary Soldier[i](the Merc Soldier is a gunman who can lead, whereas the Tactician is a Warleader who can shoot. They definitely have a ton of overlap)[BR] [I]Squadron Leader [i](SL and Tactician are definitely similar in that they are embedded in a unit to some extent. The Squadron Leader obviously belongs in space, but it has the half fighter, half leader vibe. The Tactician has a decided lean towards leadership)[BR] [I]Instructor[i](much like the SL, it's a half leader, half unit fighter. Obviously more of a defensive leader)[BR] [I]Commodore[i](Probably the closest to a space counterpart. Commodore is much better while in their signature command, but can still excel otherwise. They are much more of a utility + Leader)[BR] [I]Warleader[i](Probably the closest to a 1 for 1. It's all about leadership and survival and combat. The force element is not even as pronounced as it could have been)[BR] [I]Clone Commander[i](More of a Commodore + Strategist, but there are similarities in the percentage of leadership it does)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Micha Evron (Twilight Company)[BR] Captain Rex (Star Wars: Clone Wars)[BR] General Reikan (Empire Strikes Back)[BR]
